150.en: So when you recite the Qur'an, [first] seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the expelled [from His mercy].
Satan promises them and arouses desire in them. But Satan does not promise them except delusion.
Indeed, the wasteful are brothers of the devils, and ever has Satan been to his Lord ungrateful.

151.en: They know what is apparent of the worldly life, but they, of the Hereafter, are unaware.
[They are] those whose effort is lost in worldly life, while they think that they are doing well in work."
O my people, this worldly life is only [temporary] enjoyment, and indeed, the Hereafter - that is the home of [permanent] settlement.

152.en: [Moses] said, "That is what we were seeking." So they returned, following their footprints.
And sufficient is Allah as a witness between us and you that we were of your worship unaware."
"By Allah, we were indeed in manifest error

153.en: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them are the Gardens of Pleasure.
And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.
Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - they will have the Gardens of Paradise as a lodging,

154.en: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones]. Then see how was the end of the criminals.
Do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers
Look how they strike for you comparisons; but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way.

155.en: But the ones who strove against Our verses, [seeking] to cause failure - those are the companions of Hellfire.
And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"
And present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it -

156.en: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people -
So the people that committed wrong were eliminated. And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
How evil an example [is that of] the people who denied Our signs and used to wrong themselves.

157.en: And Ishmael and Elisha and Jonah and Lot - and all [of them] We preferred over the worlds.
And Moses said, "O Pharaoh, I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds
[This is] the revelation of the Book about which there is no doubt from the Lord of the worlds.

158.en: Those who have believed and done righteous deeds - a good state is theirs and a good return.
And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - for them is forgiveness and noble provision.
Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them are the Gardens of Pleasure.

159.en: And thus will We make some of the wrongdoers allies of others for what they used to earn.
Descendants, some of them from others. And Allah is Hearing and Knowing.
Look how We have favored [in provision] some of them over others. But the Hereafter is greater in degrees [of difference] and greater in distinction.

160.en: And they say, "O you upon whom the message has been sent down, indeed you are mad.
And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken a son." Exalted is He! Rather, they are [but] honored servants.
And they said, "We are more [than the believers] in wealth and children, and we are not to be punished."

161.en: So will they not repent to Allah and seek His forgiveness? And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
Or that He would not seize them gradually [in a state of dread]? But indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.
And ask forgiveness of your Lord and then repent to Him. Indeed, my Lord is Merciful and Affectionate."

162.en: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."
A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth]
I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of Adam].

163.en: That you not worship except Allah. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a painful day."
[It is but] a brief enjoyment, and they will have a painful punishment.
But those who strive against Our verses [seeking] to cause failure - for them will be a painful punishment of foul nature.

164.en: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allah would never send anyone [as a messenger].
As if they had never prospered therein. Then, away with Madyan as Thamud was taken away.
Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning

165.en: Then We forgave you after that so perhaps you would be grateful.
And this [Qur'an] is a Book We have revealed [which is] blessed, so follow it and fear Allah that you may receive mercy.
So when the Qur'an is recited, then listen to it and pay attention that you may receive mercy.

166.en: [Al-Khidh r] said, "Did I not say that with me you would never be able to have patience?"
They said, "We will never cease being devoted to the calf until Moses returns to us."
And they had thought, as you thought, that Allah would never send anyone [as a messenger].

167.en: Send him with us tomorrow that he may eat well and play. And indeed, we will be his guardians.
Indeed, it is We who sent down the Qur'an and indeed, We will be its guardian.
But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers."

168.en: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words.
And to Him belongs that which reposes by night and by day, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
And He subjected for you the sun and the moon, continuous [in orbit], and subjected for you the night and the day.

169.en: Who believe in the unseen, establish prayer, and spend out of what We have provided for them,
And to establish prayer and fear Him." And it is He to whom you will be gathered.
And establish prayer and give zakah and obey the Messenger - that you may receive mercy.

170.en: O you who have believed, fear Allah and be with those who are true.
[Allah] said, O Iblees, what is [the matter] with you that you are not with those who prostrate?"
Indeed, Allah is with those who fear Him and those who are doers of good.

171.en: Indeed, your Lord will judge between them by His [wise] judgement. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn].
But the people divided their religion among them into sects - each faction, in what it has, rejoicing.

172.en: But they have attributed to Him from His servants a portion. Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful.
And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but what good to him will be the remembrance?

g: He will cause you to die
172.en: And He is the one who gave you life; then He causes you to die and then will [again] give you life. Indeed, mankind is ungrateful.

173.en: But those who deny Our signs - We will progressively lead them [to destruction] from where they do not know.
But those who disbelieve and deny Our signs - those are the companions of Hellfire.
And We said, "Go both of you to the people who have denied Our signs." Then We destroyed them with [complete] destruction.

174.en: He from whom it is averted that Day - [Allah] has granted him mercy. And that is the clear attainment.
Our Lord, indeed whoever You admit to the Fire - You have disgraced him, and for the wrongdoers there are no helpers.
He who obeys the Messenger has obeyed Allah; but those who turn away - We have not sent you over them as a guardian.

175.en: These are the verses of Allah which We recite to you, [O Muhammad], in truth. And indeed, you are from among the messengers.
This is what We recite to you, [O Muhammad], of [Our] verses and the precise [and wise] message.
That is from the news of the cities, which We relate to you; of them, some are [still] standing and some are [as] a harvest [mowed down].

176.en: So when the magicians came, Moses said to them, "Throw down whatever you will throw."
And when the messengers came to the family of Lot,
And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.

177.en: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.
To whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind.
Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.

178.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "To whom belongs the earth and whoever is in it, if you should know?"
O People of the Scripture, why do you confuse the truth with falsehood and conceal the truth while you know [it]?
So do not assert similarities to Allah. Indeed, Allah knows and you do not know.

179.en: That is Paradise, which We give as inheritance to those of Our servants who were fearing of Allah.
The companions of Paradise, that Day, are [in] a better settlement and better resting place.
It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know

180.en: On a Day when their tongues, their hands and their feet will bear witness against them as to what they used to do.
Those are the companions of Paradise, abiding eternally therein as reward for what they used to do.
For them will be the Home of Peace with their Lord. And He will be their protecting friend because of what they used to do.

181.en: And if they dispute with you, then say, "Allah is most knowing of what you do.
Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.
Say, "Each works according to his manner, but your Lord is most knowing of who is best guided in way."

182.en: Go, you and your brother, with My signs and do not slacken in My remembrance.
So remind [O Muhammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.
They said, "Have you come to us with truth, or are you of those who jest?"

183.en: So let them laugh a little and [then] weep much as recompense for what they used to earn.
On the Day He will call you and you will respond with praise of Him and think that you had not remained [in the world] except for a little."
He will say, "You stayed not but a little - if only you had known.

184.en: Already the word has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.
Certainly were there in Joseph and his brothers signs for those who ask,
And if We had not strengthened you, you would have almost inclined to them a little.

185.en: And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - for them is forgiveness and noble provision.
Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them are the Gardens of Pleasure.
And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely admit them among the righteous [into Paradise].

186.en: And they say, "O you upon whom the message has been sent down, indeed you are mad.
[Al-Khidh r] said, "Did I not say that with me you would never be able to have patience?"
So adhere to that which is revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path.

187.en: To warn whoever is alive and justify the word against the disbelievers.
Do you not see that We have sent the devils upon the disbelievers, inciting them to [evil] with [constant] incitement?
True sovereignty, that Day, is for the Most Merciful. And it will be upon the disbelievers a difficult Day.

188.en: And Moses said, "O Pharaoh, I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds
And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger,
And there had certainly come to them a Messenger from among themselves, but they denied him; so punishment overtook them while they were wrongdoers.

189.en: These are the verses of Allah which We recite to you, [O Muhammad], in truth. And indeed, you are from among the messengers.
[This is] a surah which We have sent down and made [that within it] obligatory and revealed therein verses of clear evidence that you might remember.
Ta, Seen. These are the verses of the Qur'an and a clear Book

190.en: Not a [single] city which We destroyed believed before them, so will they believe?
The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] 'Aad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,
And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger,

191.en: So will they not repent to Allah and seek His forgiveness? And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

g: That He may give them in full
191.en: That He may give them in full their rewards and increase for them of His bounty. Indeed, He is Forgiving and Appreciative.
And if they cease, then indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

192.en: And they will call, "O Malik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain."
They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors.

193.en: And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say.
Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time?"
And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance.

194.en: Indeed, the first House [of worship] established for mankind was that at Makkah - blessed and a guidance for the worlds.
This [Qur'an] is notification for the people that they may be warned thereby and that they may know that He is but one God and that those of understanding will be reminded.

g: and that We (may) make it clear
195.en: And thus do We diversify the verses so the disbelievers will say, "You have studied," and so We may make the Qur'an clear for a people who know.
We recite to you from the news of Moses and Pharaoh in truth for a people who believe.
And We have certainly left of it a sign as clear evidence for a people who use reason.

196.en: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a clear authority
And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Indeed, I am to you a clear warner
But if We should send a [bad] wind and they saw [their crops] turned yellow, they would remain thereafter disbelievers.

197.en: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.
And you, [O Muhammad], were not on the western side [of the mount] when We revealed to Moses the command, and you were not among the witnesses [to that].
That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal, [O Muhammad], to you. And you were not with them when they put together their plan while they conspired.

198.en: [They will be] abiding therein forever. Indeed, Allah has with Him a great reward.
Your wealth and your children are but a trial, and Allah has with Him a great reward.
O mankind, fear your Lord. Indeed, the convulsion of the [final] Hour is a terrible thing.

199.en: So he intended to drive them from the land, but We drowned him and those with him all together.
And let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, honor [due to power] belongs to Allah entirely. He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
And [mention] the Day when He will gather them all and then say to the angels, "Did these [people] used to worship you?"
